rubric_items.reason: Every known REQ from REQ-1 to REQ-13 is traced by at least one story. The intent has no assumed or unknown REQs.
Each story has one outcome. S-1 AC5 still overlaps S-2 AC1, so the same scenario is tested in two stories.
Every criterion uses Given/When/Then and can be checked. S-1 AC3 now uses the 00:00-05:30 IST window, where the Asia/Kolkata date differs from the UTC date, so a UTC-date bug is caught.
20 per page, Asia/Kolkata, '-' and the status names all come from the intent. The early-morning test time follows from the Asia/Kolkata constraint.
Easy to read and uses the glossary status terms consistently. The S-1 AC5 / S-2 AC1 overlap is a small duplication.
